release_id.Description: Patient code in the release file names (<code>_python_friendly.mat); prefixes as given by the authors, meaning not stated in the release

cv_test_fold.Description: Cross-validation fold (1-5) in which the patient was in the test set, from the authors' complete_results_108_perm4_alllocs_v2_hist.json; n/a if the patient is not in any fold

diagnosis.Source: doi:10.1111/epi.18478 (Sundrani et al., Epilepsia 2025;66(9):3180-3192; PMC12354104) Methods

n_bipolar_channels.Description: number of bipolar channels (bip_montage_label) in the .mat file

implanted_hemisphere.Description: from lh/rh/Left/Right in the DK region labels of the bipolar channels (derived)

soz_summary.Description: DK regions with true_label 1.0 (SOZ) in the authors' results; SOZ was defined per DK region containing any contact involved in ictal onset of >=1 seizure (paper Methods). Only regions with >=4 contacts were evaluated; none_of_evaluated_regions = no evaluated region was SOZ.
